messages:
maya: Heads up — partner reported small per-device rounding that accumulates across fleets (~0.01-0.03 units/hr/device), shows as ~2-3% overage monthly.
aj: Ack. Do we have sample payload + billed number?
maya: Partner shared this redacted payload: ```{
  "account_id": "acct_XXXX",
  "ts": "2026-03-10T15:12:00Z",
  "usage_seconds": 0.48,
  "units": 0.008
}``` They claim our invoice billed 0.01 for that event.
suresh: Likely rounding order + float accumulation. We normalize to minutes somewhere, then round per-row before summing.
oliver: Marketplace spec expects seconds with up to 6 decimals; partner sends 3 decimals. Could be unit mismatch.
maya: Action: confirm whether we parsed as seconds vs minutes.
aj: I'll run a sim harness: 10k devices, both interpretations (secs vs mins) and integer vs float aggregation.
suresh: Short-term fix: convert incoming fractional seconds to integer micro-seconds (units * 1e6) and aggregate as integers until final bill rounding. Avoids incremental float rounding drift.
emily: Partner wants credits if we billed incorrectly. Need billing/legal loop for credit policy.
oliver: We'll need to identify affected accounts, compute diffs, and propose credit amounts. cc billing-ops.
aj: I'll implement parser change + unit tests today. Plan: branch -> staging Wed -> canary Fri.
maya: Also ask partner to adopt 6-decimal seconds and include explicit "units" or "unit_type" field in webhook. Add schema validation to reject ambiguous payloads.
suresh: I'll add regression tests: e.g., 0.333333s * rate -> expected total after integer aggregation. Snapshot old vs new sums.
partner-delta-bot: Created ticket PD-9873: "marketplace usage rounding discrepancy - partner acct_XXXX" assigned to @aj (P2).
emily: I can draft partner comms + credit offer. Who owns the backfill script?
aj: I'll own backfill + PR. Will post link to PD-9873 when ready.
maya: Acceptance criteria: 1) parser enforces unit field, 2) store usage as integer micro-units, 3) backfill + credit calc script, 4) partner schema update + test.
suresh: Also add billing dashboard metric: "monthly rounding drift by partner" to catch future issues.
maya: Thanks all. :raised_hands:
